Explain the concept of inheritance in Object-Oriented Programming and provide an example.
questions.questionAnswer: Inheritance is a mechanism where a new class can derive properties and behaviors from an existing class. The new class is called the derived class or child class, and the existing class is called the base class or parent class. This promotes code reusability and establishes a relationship between classes.

title: Database Design Assessment
description: Comprehensive assessment on database design principles

questions.questionText: Which normal form eliminates transitive dependencies?
Which SQL statement is used to retrieve data from a database?
Describe the difference between a primary key and a foreign key in a relational database.
questions.questionAnswer: A primary key is a column or set of columns that uniquely identifies each row in a table. A foreign key is a column or set of columns in one table that references the primary key in another table, establishing a relationship between the tables.
